#!/bin/bash
### assume etl role aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 900 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
study_abbr="activ4a" #aws s3 rm "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${study_abbr,,}/rawData/phs002694.v4.subjects.p1.activ4a.Subject.data_dict.xml" #aws s3 rm "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${study_abbr,,}/rawData/phs002694.v4.subjects.p1.ACTIV4a.Subject.data_dict.xml" #aws s3 rm "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${study_abbr,,}/rawData/phs002694.v4.subjects.p1.activ4a.Subject.MULTI.txt" #aws s3 rm "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${study_abbr,,}/rawData/phs002694.v4.subjects.p1.ACTIV4a.Subject.MULTI.txt" #aws s3 rm "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${study_abbr,,}/rawData/phs002694.v4.subjects.p1.ACTIV4A.Subject.MULTI.txt" aws s3 cp --recursive "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${study_abbr,,}/decoded_data" "./${study_abbr,,}/decoded_data"
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
